1 (Currently Amended): An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb), __further including a mixture of modified live BVDV Type la, BVDV Type 2, and a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant__.

3 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, __wherein the immunogenic composition is formulated to promote a robust immune response against the aforementioned viruses__.

4 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, __wherein the method of administration is designed for maximum immune efficacy__.

6 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen, __wherein the antigen is selected from the group consisting of those associated with infectious diseases in bovines__.

12 (Currently Amended): The vaccine of claim __11__4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of __a combination of__ at least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen.
